translations.asad: And what could make thee conceive what that sudden calamity will be?
translations.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?

translations.asad: [It will occur] on the Day when men will be like moths swarming in confusion,
translations.sahih: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,

translations.asad: and the mountains will be like fluffy tufts of wool....
translations.sahih: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.

translations.asad: And then, he whose weight [of good deeds] is heavy in the balance
translations.sahih: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],

translations.asad: shall find himself in a happy' state of life;
translations.sahih: He will be in a pleasant life.

translations.asad: whereas he whose weight is light in the balance
translations.sahih: But as for one whose scales are light,

translations.asad: shall be engulfed by an abyss.
translations.sahih: His refuge will be an abyss.

translations.asad: And what could make thee conceive what that [abyss] will be?
translations.sahih: And what can make you know what that is?
It is a Fire, intensely hot.
